story.text: At one o’clock the first of the three spirits, the Ghost of Christmas {PAST}, takes Scrooge back to his youth: to the {WAREHOUSE} of old Fezziwig, where he was an {APPRENTICE}. It is Christmas Eve, and the place is swept clean for a {BALL}. In comes a {FIDDLER}, and all the young people, and then old Fezziwig stands out to dance with Mrs. {FEZZIWIG}.
